symbols.name: AzureBlobDocumentStoreProvider
symbols.summary: Persists serialized documents in deterministic, provider-managed Azure Blob containers.
symbols.remarks: The provider requires only storage-account connectivity. For each normalized client name and document type identity it derives a deterministic container name, creates or reuses that container through an asynchronous initialization gate, and never deletes provider resources during disposal. Conditional operations use Azure ETags and serialized document metadata uses reserved bdk_ properties.
